papers.title: Absolute measurement of the Fano factor using a Skipper-CCD
papers.summary: Skipper-CCD can achieve deep sub-electron readout noise making possible the absolute determination of the exact number of ionized electrons in a large range, from 0 to above 1900 electrons. In this work we present a novel technique that exploits this unique capability to allow self-calibration and the ultimate determination of silicon properties. We performed an absolute measurement of the variance and the mean number of the charge distribution produced by $^{55}$Fe X-rays, getting a Fano factor
